_note: RECONSTRUCTED. Response of GET https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/rest-api/ms/PL/vat/7740001454 (no auth). Field names (isValid, requestDate, userError, name, address, requestIdentifier, originalVatNumber, vatNumber, viesApproximate{...}) follow the VIES REST swagger (swagger_publicVAT.yaml) as used by itaibo/vies-checker and TransactionLink docs. Poland does not disclose trader data: name/address are the literal string '---' for valid PL numbers (same as DE in rocketfellows README: 'VAT holder name: ---'). requestIdentifier is empty unless requester member state + number are supplied (POST variant). matchXxx codes: 1 = valid, 2 = invalid, 3 = not processed. Date is ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds.
